summary.zh-CN: 修复通过局域网 IP 或普通 HTTP 地址访问时聊天消息无法发送的问题。
summary.en-US: Fix chat sends when accessing NextClaw through LAN IP addresses or plain HTTP URLs.

body.zh-CN: 修复发送前出现 crypto.randomUUID is not a function 的异常，覆盖发送按钮、快捷键和菜单预设消息，并保留接收确认与幂等重试。
body.en-US: Fix the crypto.randomUUID is not a function error before submission, covering the send button, keyboard sends and menu presets while preserving acceptance tracking and idempotent retries.
